label: Life evaluation

source.name: World Happiness Report 2026 / Gallup World Poll
source.citation: Helliwell, J. F., Layard, R., Sachs, J. D., De Neve, J.-E., Aknin, L. B., & Wang, S. (Eds.). (2026). World Happiness Report 2026. University of Oxford: Wellbeing Research Centre.
source.extraction: Numeric scores and published ranks parsed from the official PDF text. The official XLSX was identified but the tool could not materialize that content type. No values were estimated or imputed.

measurement: National survey averages of answers to the Cantril Ladder life-evaluation question on a 0–10 scale, averaged over the report’s 2023–2025 window where available. These are reported life evaluations, not a composite score of six explanatory factors. Ranks and rank confidence intervals are those published by WHR.

license.note: The official site allows the Figure 2.1 data to be downloaded for free. It does not state an explicit CC or commercial redistribution license on the consulted data-sharing or FAQ pages. Do not treat a free-download statement as a commercial license; confirm permission before selling this layer or redistributing it as a paid dataset.
